template.title: The Sticky Note Adventure
template.summary: A child discovers a series of friendly notes that turn into a playful treasure hunt, ending with a surprise hug and treat.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] stared at the sticky note on the [[slot_spot]], wondering what the note said.
The note read, "Who is the best?" and it made [[slot_child]] giggle.
[[slot_child]] wrote a reply on a fresh piece of paper, drawing a big smiley face with silly glasses.
The reply was hidden in the [[slot_spot]] for the next note to find.
The next morning, [[slot_child]] found another note that said, "Find the blue box in the kitchen."
[[slot_child]] searched the kitchen, looking under the stove, behind the fridge, and inside the pantry, until a blue box popped out.
Inside the box was a tiny treasure: a [[slot_treat]] and a note that said, "You did great!"
[[slot_child]] felt warm and happy, and then a sticky note appeared on the bathroom mirror, drawing a smiley face with silly glasses.
The note said, "I am the [[slot_writer]] who sent you the notes, and I love seeing you smile."
[[slot_child]] ran to the kitchen, where the [[slot_writer]] was waiting with a hug and a secret treat.
They shared the [[slot_treat]] together, laughing and planning the next note adventure.
At bedtime, [[slot_child]] tucked the last note into the [[slot_spot]] and dreamed of more friendly messages.
